# Python packages the tool uses at run time: the XLSX publishers (openpyxl) and the
# questionnaire PDF importers (pypdf). Installed with --require-hashes and
# --only-binary=:all:, so pip accepts only these exact releases. Dependabot (the pip
# ecosystem for /.github, weekly, 7-day cooldown) proposes new versions with new hashes.
# Install-TPPrerequisites.ps1 reads the version of each package from this file; the
# SBOM generator and the docs must agree with it (TP.RuntimePins.Tests.ps1 checks).
